title: KBG Technologies: New sales and quoting system | enCloud9
meta: How enCloud9 implemented Dynamics 365 for KBG Technologies in Memphis, adding pipeline management, quoting and data migration within two months.
h1: One platform for sales and quoting
answer: KBG Technologies is a new Memphis, TN company providing chemical solutions for water systems and the pulp and paper industries. It ran solely on QuickBooks, which was not enough for its growing needs. We implemented Dynamics 365 with pipeline management, quoting and data migration. Within two months KBG had one platform for its sales activity.
facts: Chemical solutions for water systems and the pulp and paper industries
outcomes: The project was completed within two months.
KBG gained a centralized platform for all sales-related activities, from client communication to quoting and document storage.
Its ability to track and manage sales processes improved.
KBG was particularly pleased with the improved quoting process.
chapters: KBG Technologies is a new company that specializes in advanced chemical solutions for water systems and the pulp and paper industries. As a new company, it wanted efficient systems for client communication, sales pipelines and quoting.
KBG initially operated solely on QuickBooks, which was insufficient for its growing business needs.
We implemented Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement. Sales pipeline management lets KBG track communications with customers and prospects, monitor opportunities and report on pipeline status.
We set up a quoting system and migrated data from KBG's existing systems.

KBG now manages all sales-related activities on one platform, from client communication to quoting and document storage. That improved its ability to track and manage sales processes and supports better decision-making and customer engagement.
next_steps: KBG plans to continue its partnership with enCloud9 for ongoing support and potential future projects, including order management.
author: Kristin Caniglia
